prayerExcerpt.en-US: Blessed the Father of compassion and God of all encouragement, who encourages us in our every affliction.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Bendito seja o Pai misericordioso, que em todo sofrimento nos consola!

meta.face: A man of about fifty with a full, pear-shaped face — narrow at the temples and widening to heavy, low cheeks and a broad, rounded jaw; a short, straight nose with a broad bridge; heavy-lidded dark eyes under thick, low, almost horizontal brows; a small, full-lipped, closed mouth; clean-shaven, short dark hair greying at the temples below the mitre, the eyes lowered in thought, and a grave, gentle expression.
meta.basis: Polish tradition shows him clean-shaven: Samostrzelnik's miniature (c. 1530s) with a full, heavy-lidded face, and Kuntze's Raising of Piotrowin with dark hair. He died at forty-eight; the sword and Piotr are his usual attributes.
